name: messel_snake_slab
description: Messel oil-shale slab (dark grey-brown #4a4038, faint bedding lines, chipped corner) holding a coiled fossil snake skeleton: cream vertebrae and rib fans along a looping body, small skull at the left, tapering tail at the lower right. Inside its belly at local (+40,+20) lies a small pale lizard skeleton (spine, skull facing right, four limbs, tail). Anchor centre, ~644x424.
